caption: Your to-do list isn’t a plan; urgency wins but impact loses. Five prompts help you diagnose, improve, apply, check, and refine priorities with AI. Save for weekly use. What task steals your focus today? #AIforProductivity #Prioritization #ProductivityHacks

slides.title: Stop Urgency-Only Prioritizing
slides.body: Urgency-first lists waste time. Use a smarter 2D matrix to choose tasks by impact and effort. Five prompts follow.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priorities
slides.body: Prompt: Given tasks: [paste], rate impact (H/M/L) and effort (H/M/L); output a 2x2 map and ranked list; format: bullets.

slides.title: 2. Improve options
slides.body: Prompt: For each top-priority task, propose 2–3 options to lower effort or raise impact; include trade-offs; format: short options.

slides.title: 3. Plan execution
slides.body: Prompt: Create a 5-day plan mapping top tasks to days, with time-box estimates and simple dependencies; format: daily list.

slides.title: 4. Check alignment
slides.body: Prompt: Compare plan to goals; flag tasks missing outcomes or needing uncertain effort; format: flags + rationale.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Prompt: Produce a reusable 2-step daily priority refresh; output: short list, date, next action; format: checklist.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Takeaway: Use a reusable weekly prioritization routine with AI prompts; save this and follow @naelbuildingbig for more.
